data.name: Home_GapTitle
data.value: A Structural Gap at the Heart of European Academia

data.name: Home_GapDesc1
data.value: The rapid evolution of blockchain technologies and the cryptoeconomy has outpaced academic frameworks, leaving a critical gap in European higher education.

data.name: Home_GapDesc2
data.value: This conference serves as a platform for systematic dialogue between academia, regulators, and industry to bridge this divide.

data.name: Home_Quote
data.value: "We are not convening to discuss blockchain. We are convening to build the academic architecture that governs its transfer into a tangible, structured, and recognized new European educational field."

data.name: Home_Deliv1_Desc
data.value: Shared academic standards for cryptoeconomics education, formally adopted across European universities.

data.name: Home_Deliv2_Desc
data.value: A permanent international consortium enabling ongoing research exchange and faculty collaboration.

data.name: Home_Deliv3_Desc
data.value: Implementation-ready models for new university programs, blockchain labs, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

data.name: Home_Deliv4_Desc
data.value: Foundations for funded collaboration between higher education and leading Web3 industry actors in DeFi and asset tokenization.

data.name: Home_Dom1_Desc
data.value: Curriculum design, quality benchmarks, cross-institutional alignment, and the Sofia Declaration framework.

data.name: Home_Dom2_Desc
data.value: European regulatory frameworks and their direct impact on academic programs and infrastructure.

data.name: Home_Dom3_Desc
data.value: DeFi, RWA tokenization, blockchain-AI convergence, and emerging paradigms in digital finance.

data.name: Home_Dom4_Desc
data.value: Academic research translation, joint projects, and innovation labs.

data.name: Home_CtaTitle
data.value: The development of blockchain technologies and cryptoeconomics.

data.name: Home_CtaPara1
data.value: The development of blockchain technologies and cryptoeconomics relies on a continuous dialogue between academia, regulators, and industry. The creation of a recognized educational program with varying depth and refined academic standards.

data.name: Home_CtaPara2
data.value: The International Conference on Academic Standards in Cryptoeconomics and Blockchain creates a platform for systematic dialogue between universities, research institutes, and practitioners. Organized by UNWE, the Institute of Cryptoeconomics, Blockchain and Innovations (ICBI), and the National Association for Blockchain and Innovations (NABI). Together, we bring academia, regulators, and industry into a shared space focused on quality education, research, and innovation.
